title: The Mask of Zorro
tagline: The mask passes on. So does the recipe.
about: An ageing Zorro trains a young thief to take his place and avenge his family in old California.
cue: Serve the mains when Alejandro and Elena dance at the governor's party.
faces: Alta California, the old days. The mask passes on. So does the recipe.
I. The mark of Z cut with a blade.
III. Alejandro learning in a hidden cave.
A fox is quick, but a student must be quicker. Eat well, then we practice the sword at dawn.
Red wine chorizo, Manchego with quince paste, warm olives with orange peel.
Monterey Jack and roasted green chilli quesadillas with a Z scored on top.
The Mexican families of old California.

CaliforniaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Masa beaten light with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in red chilli sauce, folded and steamed until firm.Soak 16 dried corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes.Poach 500g chicken thighs, shred and mix with 250ml red enchilada sauce.Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 450g masa harina, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 450ml warm chicken stock.Spread 3 tbsp masa on each husk, add a spoon of chicken, fold and stand upright in a steamer.Steam covered for 75 minutes and serve with salsa.MainsDon Diego's rancho
